<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Bamboo Box Kite</title>

  <style>
    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html,
    body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #b9dce5;
      font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont,
        "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      touch-action: none;
      cursor: grab;
    }

    canvas:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }

    .title-card {
      position: fixed;
      top: 24px;
      left: 24px;
      z-index: 10;
      max-width: min(360px, calc(100vw - 48px));
      padding: 17px 20px;
      color: #fffaf0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(31, 48, 42, 0.86), rgba(31, 48, 42, 0.62));
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
      border-radius: 14px;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(18, 34, 29, 0.2);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      color: #e4c477;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.24em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    h1 {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size: clamp(25px, 4vw, 38px);
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .subtitle {
      margin-top: 9px;
      color: rgba(255, 250, 240, 0.76);
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .controls {
      position: fixed;
      right: 20px;
      bottom: 20px;
      z-index: 10;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      background: rgba(28, 43, 37, 0.68);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      border-radius: 999px;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(18, 34, 29, 0.18);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      font-size: 11px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    button {
      padding: 7px 11px;
      color: #fffaf0;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
      border-radius: 999px;
      font: inherit;
      font-size: 11px;
      cursor: pointer;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    button:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    }

    .loading {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 30;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      color: #fffaf0;
      background: #b9dce5;
      font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      font-size: 22px;
      transition: opacity 0.5s ease;
    }

    .loading.hidden {
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .title-card {
        top: 14px;
        left: 14px;
        padding: 14px 16px;
      }

      .controls {
        right: 12px;
        bottom: 12px;
      }

      .controls span {
        display: none;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <canvas id="scene" aria-label="Interactive 3D bamboo-framed box kite"></canvas>

  <section class="title-card">
    <div class="eyebrow">Traditional Craft</div>
    <h1>Bamboo Box Kite</h1>
    <div class="subtitle">
      A hand-framed red silk kite with woven bamboo, a deep tail, and floating in a
      softly lit afternoon sky.
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="controls">
    <span>Drag to orbit · Scroll to zoom</span>
    <button id="reset" type="button">Reset view</button>
  </div>

  <div id="loading" class="loading">Preparing the kite…</div>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const canvas = document.querySelector("#scene");
    const loading = document.querySelector("#loading");
    const resetButton = document.querySelector("#reset");

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer and scene
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      canvas,
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.08;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xb9dce5);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xb9dce5, 28, 78);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      38,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      150
    );

    const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.7, 0);

    const desiredView = {
      radius: 17.5,
      theta: 0.34,
      phi: 1.18
    };

    const currentView = { ...desiredView };

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lighting
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xe8f7ff, 0x66734b, 2.15);
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff0cf, 3.4);
    sun.position.set(-9, 14, 10);
    sun.castShadow = true;
    sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    sun.shadow.camera.left = -13;
    sun.shadow.camera.right = 13;
    sun.shadow.camera.top = 13;
    sun.shadow.camera.bottom = -13;
    sun.shadow.camera.near = 1;
    sun.shadow.camera.far = 40;
    sun.shadow.bias = -0.0004;
    sun.shadow.normalBias = 0.025;
    scene.add(sun);

    const rimLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xb8e4ff, 1.1);
    rimLight.position.set(10, 4, -12);
    scene.add(rimLight);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural sky
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const sky = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(70, 32, 18),
      new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
        side: THREE.BackSide,
        depthWrite: false,
        uniforms: {
          topColor: { value: new THREE.Color(0x78b9d1) },
          horizonColor: { value: new THREE.Color(0xe8e4cc) }
        },
        vertexShader: `
          varying vec3 vWorldPosition;

          void main() {
            vec4 worldPosition = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
            vWorldPosition = worldPosition.xyz;
            gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * worldPosition;
          }
        `,
        fragmentShader: `
          uniform vec3 topColor;
          uniform vec3 horizonColor;
          varying vec3 vWorldPosition;

          void main() {
            float h = normalize(vWorldPosition).y;
            float blend = smoothstep(-0.12, 0.72, h);
            gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(horizonColor, topColor, blend), 1.0);
          }
        `
      })
    );

    scene.add(sky);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Materials
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const bambooMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xc5a45b,
      roughness: 0.58,
      metalness: 0.02
    });

    const bambooNodeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x987635,
      roughness: 0.66
    });

    const braceMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xd5b96d,
      roughness: 0.52
    });

    const stringMaterial = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
      color: 0x3d3b32,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.82
    });

    const creamMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xf2e5c4,
      roughness: 0.8
    });

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural red silk texture
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    function createSilkTexture() {
      const textureCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      textureCanvas.width = 1024;
      textureCanvas.height = 768;

      const context = textureCanvas.getContext("2d");
      const gradient = context.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 768);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, "#a93530");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.5, "#c64b3c");
      gradient.addColorStop(1, "#8f2e2d");

      context.fillStyle = gradient;
      context.fillRect(0, 0, 1024, 768);

      // Fine woven-fabric lines.
      context.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let x = 0; x < 1024; x += 4) {
        context.strokeStyle = x % 8 === 0 ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.035)" : "rgba(60,15,15,0.055)";
        context.beginPath();
        context.moveTo(x, 0);
        context.lineTo(x, 768);
        context.stroke();
      }

      for (let y = 0; y < 768; y += 5) {
        context.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.025)";
        context.beginPath();
        context.moveTo(0, y);
        context.lineTo(1024, y);
        context.stroke();
      }

      // Cream border.
      context.strokeStyle = "rgba(242,229,196,0.8)";
      context.lineWidth = 18;
      context.strokeRect(24, 24, 976, 720);
      context.lineWidth = 5;
      context.strokeRect(45, 45, 934, 678);

      // Central circular motif.
      context.fillStyle = "#243b34";
      context.beginPath();
      context.arc(512, 384, 158, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      context.fill();

      context.strokeStyle = "#f0d99b";
      context.lineWidth = 12;
      context.beginPath();
      context.arc(512, 384, 118, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      context.stroke();

      context.fillStyle = "#e6ad45";
      context.beginPath();
      context.arc(512, 384, 72, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      context.fill();

      // Corner decorations.
      const corners = [
        [90, 90, 118],
        [926, 90, 118],
        [926, 678, 118],
        [90, 678, 118]
      ];

      for (const [x, y, radius] of corners) {
        context.strokeStyle = "rgba(242,229,196,0.75)";
        context.lineWidth = 10;
        context.strokeRect(x - radius, y - radius, radius * 2, radius * 2);

        context.strokeStyle = "rgba(36,59,52,0.8)";
        context.lineWidth = 5;
        context.strokeRect(x + 8, y + 8, radius * 2 - 16, radius * 2 - 16);
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(textureCanvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    const silkTexture = createSilkTexture();

    const silkMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      map: silkTexture,
      color: 0xffffff,
      roughness: 0.88,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide
    });

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Geometry helpers
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    function cylinderBetween(start, end, radius, material, radialSegments = 10) {
      const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(end, start);
      const length = direction.length();

      const geometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
        radius,
        radius,
        length,
        radialSegments
      );

      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      mesh.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
        direction.normalize()
      );

      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      return mesh;
    }

    function addNode(position, orientation = "z") {
      const node = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.15, 0.023, 6, 14),
        bambooNodeMaterial
      );

      node.position.copy(position);

      if (orientation === "y") {
        node.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
      } else if (orientation === "x") {
        node.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
      }

      node.castShadow = true;
      return node;
    }

    function makeLine(start, end) {
      const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([
        start,
        end
      ]);

      return new THREE.Line(geometry, stringMaterial);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Bamboo box kite
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const kite = new THREE.Group();
    kite.position.y = 0.15;
    scene.add(kite);

    const frame = new THREE.Group();
    kite.add(frame);

    const halfWidth = 3.8;
    const halfHeight = 2.8;
    const frontZ = 0.72;
    const backZ = -0.72;

    // Front and back outer frames.
    for (const z of [frontZ, backZ]) {
      frame.add(
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(-halfWidth, -halfHeight, z),
          new THREE.Vector3(halfWidth, -halfHeight, z),
          0.145,
          bambooMaterial
        ),
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(-halfWidth, halfHeight, z),
          new THREE.Vector3(halfWidth, halfHeight, z),
          0.145,
          bambooMaterial
        ),
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(-halfWidth, -halfHeight, z),
          new THREE.Vector3(-halfWidth, halfHeight, z),
          0.145,
          bambooMaterial
        ),
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(halfWidth, -halfHeight, z),
          new THREE.Vector3(halfWidth, halfHeight, z),
          0.145,
          bambooMaterial
        )
      );

      // Crisscross bracing on the front and back.
      frame.add(
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(-halfWidth, halfHeight, z + (z > 0 ? 0.045 : -0.045)),
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, z + (z > 0 ? 0.045 : -0.045)),
          0.055,
          braceMaterial
        ),
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(halfWidth, halfHeight, z + (z > 0 ? 0.045 : -0.045)),
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, z + (z > 0 ? 0.045 : -0.045)),
          0.055,
          braceMaterial
        ),
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(-halfWidth, -halfHeight, z + (z > 0 ? 0.045 : -0.045)),
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, z + (z > 0 ? 0.045 : -0.045)),
          0.055,
          braceMaterial
        ),
        cylinderBetween(
          new THREE.Vector3(halfWidth, -halfHeight, z + (z > 0 ? 0.045 : -0.045)),
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, z + (z > 0 ? 0.045 : -0.045)),
          0.055,
          braceMaterial
        )
      );
    }

    // Depth rails connecting the front and back frames.
    frame.add(
      cylinderBetween(
        new THREE.Vector3(-halfWidth, halfHeight, frontZ),
        new THREE.Vector3(-halfWidth, halfHeight, backZ),
        0.13,
        bambooMaterial
      ),
      cylinderBetween(
        new THREE.Vector3(halfWidth, halfHeight, frontZ),
        new THREE.Vector3(halfWidth, halfHeight, backZ),
        0.13,
        bambooMaterial
      ),
      cylinderBetween(
        new THREE.Vector3(-halfWidth, -halfHeight, frontZ),
        new THREE.Vector3(-halfWidth, -halfHeight, backZ),
        0.13,
        bambooMaterial
      ),
      cylinderBetween(
        new THREE.Vector3(halfWidth, -halfHeight, frontZ),
        new THREE.Vector3(halfWidth, -halfHeight, backZ),
        0.13,
        bambooMaterial
      ),
      cylinderBetween(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, halfHeight, frontZ),
        new THREE.Vector3(0, halfHeight, backZ),
        0.115,
        bambooMaterial
      ),
      cylinderBetween(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, -halfHeight, frontZ),
        new THREE.Vector3(0, -halfHeight, backZ),
        0.115,
        bambooMaterial
      ),
      cylinderBetween(
        new THREE.Vector3(-halfWidth, 0, frontZ),
        new THREE.Vector3(-halfWidth, 0, backZ),
        0.115,
        bambooMaterial
      ),
      cylinderBetween(
        new THREE.Vector3(halfWidth, 0, frontZ),
        new THREE.Vector3(halfWidth, 0, backZ),
        0.115,
        bambooMaterial
      )
    );

    // Bamboo nodes.
    for (const x of [-halfWidth, halfWidth]) {
      for (const y of [-2.4, -0.8, 0.8, 2.4]) {
        for (const z of [frontZ, backZ]) {
          frame.add(addNode(new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z), "y"));
        }
      }
    }

    for (const y of [-halfHeight, halfHeight]) {
      for (const z of [frontZ, backZ]) {
        for (const x of [-3, -1, 1, 3]) {
          frame.add(addNode(new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z), "x"));
        }
      }

      for (const x of [0]) {
        for (const z of [-0.35, 0.35]) {
          frame.add(addNode(new THREE.Vector3(0, y, z), "z"));
        }
      }
    }

    for (const x of [-halfWidth, halfWidth]) {
      for (const z of [-0.35, 0.35]) {
        frame.add(addNode(new THREE.Vector3(x, 0, z), "z"));
      }
    }

    // Red silk panels.
    const frontPanel = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(7.36, 5.36),
      silkMaterial
    );
    frontPanel.position.z = 0.68;
    frontPanel.castShadow = true;
    frontPanel.receiveShadow = true;
    kite.add(frontPanel);

    const backPanel = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(7.36, 5.36),
      silkMaterial
    );
    backPanel.position.z = -0.68;
    backPanel.castShadow = true;
    kite.add(backPanel);

    const sidePanelGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.43, 5.36);

    for (const x of [-3.83, 3.83]) {
      const sidePanel = new THREE.Mesh(sidePanelGeometry, silkMaterial);
      sidePanel.position.set(x, 0, 0);
      sidePanel.rotation.y = x > 0 ? Math.PI / 2 : -Math.PI / 2;
      sidePanel.castShadow = true;
      sidePanel.receiveShadow = true;
      kite.add(sidePanel);
    }

    // Small cream corner knots.
    const knotPositions = [
      [-3.45, 2.42],
      [3.45, 2.42],
      [-3.45, -2.42],
      [3.45, -2.42]
    ];

    for (const [x, y] of knotPositions) {
      const knot = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.13, 12, 8),
        creamMaterial
      );
      knot.position.set(x, y, 0.82);
      knot.scale.z = 0.55;
      knot.castShadow = true;
      kite.add(knot);
    }

    // Tail pivot and striped tail.
    const tailPivot = new THREE.Group();
    tailPivot.position.set(0, -2.8, 0.72);
    kite.add(tailPivot);

    const tailTextureCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    tailTextureCanvas.width = 256;
    tailTextureCanvas.height = 1024;

    const tailContext = tailTextureCanvas.getContext("2d");
    tailContext.fillStyle = "#a93530";
    tailContext.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 1024);

    tailContext.strokeStyle = "#f0e2bf";
    tailContext.lineWidth = 24;
    tailContext.strokeRect(12, 12, 232, 996);
    tailContext.lineWidth = 4;
    tailContext.strokeRect(35, 35, 186, 954);

    const tailTexture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(tailTextureCanvas);
    tailTexture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;

    const tail = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.58, 5.4),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        map: tailTexture,
        roughness: 0.9,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide
      })
    );
    tail.position.y = -2.7;
    tail.castShadow = true;
    tailPivot.add(tail);

    // Cream tip.
    const tailTip = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.62, 0.48),
      creamMaterial
    );
    tailTip.position.y = -5.32;
    tailTip.rotation.x = -0.08;
    tailTip.castShadow = true;
    tailPivot.add(tailTip);

    // Top spool and bridle lines.
    const spoolPoint = new THREE.Vector3(0, 3.2, 0.25);

    frame.add(
      cylinderBetween(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 3.12, 0.25),
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 3.48, 0.25),
        0.085,
        bambooNodeMaterial
      )
    );

    const spoolCap = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.14, 0.14, 0.08, 16),
      creamMaterial
    );
    spoolCap.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
    spoolCap.position.set(0, 3.48, 0.25);
    spoolCap.castShadow = true;
    kite.add(spoolCap);

    for (const x of [-halfWidth, halfWidth]) {
      kite.add(
        makeLine(
          new THREE.Vector3(x, halfHeight, frontZ + 0.04),
          spoolPoint
        ),
        makeLine(
          new THREE.Vector3(x, -halfHeight, frontZ + 0.04),
          new THREE.Vector3(0, -2.35, 0.76)
        ),
        makeLine(
          new THREE.Vector3(x, -halfHeight, frontZ + 0.04),
          new THREE.Vector3(0, -4.0, 0.76)
        ),
        makeLine(
          new THREE.Vector3(x, -halfHeight, frontZ + 0.04),
          new THREE.Vector3(0, -5.3, 0.76)
        )
      );
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Ground, distant mountains, trees, and clouds
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(120, 120),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x71855d,
        roughness: 1
      })
    );
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    ground.position.y = -8.75;
    ground.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(ground);

    let randomSeed = 92741;
    function random() {
      randomSeed = (randomSeed * 16807) % 2147483647;
      return (randomSeed - 1) / 2147483646;
    }

    const mountainMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x6e8876,
      roughness: 1
    });

    const mountainMaterials = [
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x78907c, roughness: 1 }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x5f7d6d, roughness: 1 }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x82957b, roughness: 1 })
    ];

    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const height = 6 + random() * 7;
      const radius = 8 + random() * 10;
      const mountain = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.ConeGeometry(radius, height, 5),
        mountainMaterials[i % mountainMaterials.length]
      );

      mountain.position.set(
        -30 + i * 10 + random() * 4,
        height / 2 - 9.1,
        -24 - random() * 18
      );
      mountain.rotation.y = random() * Math.PI;
      mountain.scale.z = 0.65 + random() * 0.5;
      mountain.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(mountain);
    }

    const trunkMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x65503a,
      roughness: 1
    });

    const foliageMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x3f6847,
      roughness: 0.95
    });

    const foliageLightMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x52794f,
      roughness: 0.95
    });

    function createTree(x, z, scale) {
      const tree = new THREE.Group();
      tree.position.set(x, -8.7, z);
      tree.scale.setScalar(scale);

      const trunk = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.18, 0.28, 2.4, 8),
        trunkMaterial
      );
      trunk.position.y = 1.2;
      trunk.castShadow = true;
      tree.add(trunk);

      const foliage = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.ConeGeometry(1.25, 3.2, 8),
        random() > 0.5 ? foliageMaterial : foliageLightMaterial
      );
      foliage.position.y = 3.05;
      foliage.castShadow = true;
      tree.add(foliage);

      scene.add(tree);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const distance = 11 + random() * 28;
      createTree(
        Math.cos(angle) * distance,
        Math.sin(angle) * distance,
        0.7 + random() * 1.1
      );
    }

    const cloudMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.76,
      depthWrite: false
    });

    const clouds = [];

    function createCloud(x, y, z, scale) {
      const cloud = new THREE.Group();
      cloud.position.set(x, y, z);
      cloud.scale.setScalar(scale);

      const puffs = [
        [-1.4, 0, 0, 1.0],
        [-0.55, 0.28, 0, 1.25],
        [0.5, 0.1, 0, 1.0],
        [1.35, -0.05, 0, 0.75],
        [0, -0.18, 0.15, 1.15]
      ];

      for (const [px, py, pz, scale] of puffs) {
        const puff = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.85, 12, 8),
          cloudMaterial
        );
        puff.position.set(px, py, pz);
        puff.scale.set(scale * 1.35, scale * 0.65, scale * 0.65);
        cloud.add(puff);
      }

      scene.add(cloud);
      clouds.push(cloud);
    }

    createCloud(-10, 13, -22, 1.7);
    createCloud(12, 17, -30, 2.1);
    createCloud(22, 10, -15, 1.25);
    createCloud(-20, 8, -28, 1.4);

    const sunDisc = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(2.2, 20, 12),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffe6a5 })
    );
    sunDisc.position.set(-20, 19, -38);
    scene.add(sunDisc);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Floating pollen / atmospheric particles
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const particleCount = 180;
    const particlePositions = new Float32Array(particleCount * 3);

    for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
      particlePositions[i * 3] = (random() - 0.5) * 34;
